notes.title: Character Customization Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We've been working on a few features that will help steer the game towards our long-term goal. 
We're excited to announce the beginning of the integration with Steam's Inventory Service. Through gameplay you can obtain cosmetic items which will show in your Steam Inventory. These items can be traded or sold as well! Currently we have hats, shirts, pants and bullet trails available. We are also considering the possibility of including Workshop integration to allow players to create their own styles, but that's still a while away.
Furthermore, we have begun to develop skills, they are currently divided into two categories: quick skills, which are intended to be used to create an immediate impact and lasting skills, which should grant some benefit or effect over a longer period of time. You can pick one of each before every run and multiplayer session for now, but eventually this will be further tied into the game mechanics.
Both these features are accessible through a new option (Character) in the menu, where you can also set your character's physical features such as face, eyes, hair and more.
Soon we will also have some rewards for challenge winners and top placing players, and don't worry, previous challenge participants will be rewarded too!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes: Fix some minor bugs and add interpolation to character - player characters now move more smoothly!

notes.title: Minor update

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
Bugfix: gatling's gun was jammed! Not anymore, be careful ;)

Also would like to anticipate that we're working on improving boss AI and adding personality traits so that they will behave slightly differently one from another.

notes.title: Update (v 0.12.7)
notes.notes:
- Added "reloading" mechanic. Players now have 6 bullets per round, after which the character will automatically reload. At any time, however, players may reload (R on keyboard, RB/R1 on controllers). Enemies also have limited bullets per round, this will be most noticeable on the behavior of Bandits. This rule also applies to multiplayer mode.
- Fixed issue with controllers not aiming.
- Added controller icons to tutorial screens.
- Added "controls" screen to "Settings" menu. Currently still not able to change the keymapping though, this is still in progress.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed game not restarting correctly after dying and player information HUD not properly displaying player's data.

notes.title: Update - v0.10.0
notes.notes:
Many small polishments have been made in this update, mostly cosmetic.

[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added "stomp" to tutorial.
[*] Removed "Friendly Fire" and "Respawn Enemies" options from Settings.
[*] Improved bullet trail shader.
[*] Props now can be placed at different depths to create a better environment.
[*] Tweaked the visuals of day and night levels.
[*] Camera now clamps to floor at night-level as well.
[*] Improved character collision logic in regards to walls.
[*] Slightly increased size of trapdoors.
[*] Slightly adjusted colliders on rock platforms.
[*] Fixed bogus spawn points in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed some small gaps in floor that ate bullets.
[*] Fixed placement of some objects
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.9.6
notes.notes:
This update brings some gameplay changes. Now you can kill enemies by stomping on their heads, just like those brothers with moustaches. Also, now friendly fire is not deadly, but it is stunning... literally. A tutorial level has been created. We know you guys are all pros by now, but since there was no tutorial previously, the system has flagged everyone as a newbie. Go beat that tutorial like a boss. Since we are now going to be in Early Access, an icon has been added to the UI to make it clear that the game is in Early Access state.


[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Players can now stomp enemies.
[*] Friendly fire now causes Stun.
[*] Added tutorial level.
[*] Added Early Access icon to UI.
[*] Fixed placement of some elements that made it hard to access a specific trap door.
[*] Removed the floating skull that showed up occasionally.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.9.0 alpha

[u]Change List[/u]

[*] New achievement.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.8.17 alpha
notes.notes:
Added Challenges. Play a specific level with specific rules to earn a place on the leaderboard. Challenges change every sunday!



[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added Challenges.
[*] Save character appearance to Steam Cloud.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Achievements could trigger in-game even if the player had already earned them in a previous gaming session.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Character Editor UI had some fields misbehaving depending on resolution.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Bandits had bad pivot and this caused them to occasionally cross walls.
